notes: Synthetic staff-style requests written 2026-11-27 that fit two or more Skills which would produce different work, with nothing in the request saying which. Asking which one is meant is allowed here (not required); on the routing benchmark's clear requests it counts as over-asking.
Used by `npm run eval:selection` with STEP_EVAL_CLARIFY=1 or both. A question counts as fitting when at least two of its options are in `fits`.
